summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Form 424B5) for a public offering of multiple series of senior unsecured notes. The filing states the notes are investment-grade debt, with specific terms (maturities, interest rates, redemption provisions) to be finalized at pricing. There is no change of control, merger, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation catalyst. The offering is a routine capital markets debt issuance under an existing shelf registration. No special-situation event is present.
